static_traits.name: Chen Ming
static_traits.family_status: A mother of two boys, ex-husband occasionally visiting
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in, but feeling they may not understand the complex situation of being undervalued as a mother
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet faced similar problems; no prior psychotherapy/psychological problem history; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone, clear expression; able to describe events and feelings concretely; tending to personalize problems and use 'should' statements; fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: Since my ex-husband returned to town to visit, I feel my two sons no longer want to spend time with me, which has produced a sense of inadequacy as a parent and feeling excluded.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want them to want to be with me again. I want to feel like I'm an important part of their lives.' (I hope they will once again want to be with me. I hope I am an important part of their lives.)

core_beliefs: I am not as good as their father

special_situations.event: The ex-husband returns to town to visit; the two sons prefer to be with him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the children prefer being with their father, it means I am not good enough as a mother and I am not important
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively talks with the children about one's feelings, trying to gain their attention and explanations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want me, I am an incompetent mother

special_situations.event: When the children went out with their father, they did not actively update me on their activity plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the children do not take the initiative to inform me of their schedules, it means they do not respect me and my status at home is very low
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In my mind I set rules for the children and require them to report activities to me 'at the very least'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They should at least tell me what they are doing

special_situations.event: After expressing feelings to the children, the children dismissively say they just miss their father
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my feelings are not valued, it proves I am too sensitive / complaining
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops bringing the matter up again to avoid being seen as complaining
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too sensitive, better not to say more

special_situations.event: Notices that the ex-husband is seen as the 'fun parent', while I am responsible for maintaining housework and order
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not 'fun', I am not worthy of the children liking and being close to me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing myself with my ex-husband and devaluing myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as their father

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be attached to and valued by the children
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored, excluded from the family, losing one's sense of worth as a mother
defense_goal: Avoiding the pain of being rejected through self-restraint and no longer expressing needs
Reduces emotional expression to maintain surface harmony

object_relations.self_representation: A neglected bystander, a mother feeling not valued
object_relations.object_representation: The child (and ex-husband) are people who prefer the father and ignore me

object_relations.self_representation: Not interesting enough, a mother who only maintains order
object_relations.object_representation: Father is the 'fun one' loved by the children

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the child preferring to be with the father, or being asked about one's feelings in the parent-child relationship
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying about complaining and being judged as overly sensitive, thus not worthy of expressing needs (declining self-evaluation to avoid external denial)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained tone, avoiding directly expressing dissatisfaction, using more self-blaming statements (such as 'I am too sensitive'), lowering emotional intensity.

manifestations: Feels like an 'outsider', excluded in her own home
Interaction with children decreases, the subjective experience of being ignored worsens
Doubting one's role value as a mother
Feeling 'I am not as good as their father'

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-reflection and self-reproach, being overly cautious in contacting others and situations.
manifestations: Blaming oneself as 'too sensitive' / 'sounding like complaining'
Reduces self-expression to avoid being judged

contact_model.definition: Turns the energy originally intended for outward expression back onto oneself, restrains actions or requests toward others.
manifestations: Stops mentioning one's own feelings and needs
No longer discussing this with the children to avoid conflict

contact_model.definition: Taking external rules and expectations as one's own absolute standards in an undigested way.
manifestations: Using rule-based language like 'they should at least...'
Demands the child's behavior by 'should' standards while ignoring situational differences

positive_force: Previously close with the children, able to play games and watch movies together
Willing to communicate proactively and seek professional counseling help
Has some social support (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: Tending to personalize problems and self-denial
Sets rigid rules with 'should' statements, dependent on external evaluation
Making unfavorable comparisons with the ex-husband, devaluing oneself
Low mood and decreased motivation, affecting daily functioning and interaction

antecedent: The child prefers spending time with the father
The children not yet actively updating activity plans
Brushed-off response after communicating with the child
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing the children's choices, interpreting relationships with 'should' rules and comparing with the ex-husband, leading to rejection feelings and self-denial
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the pain of being rejected, gaining a sense of control through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation, difficulty completing daily tasks, reduced interaction with children, impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding further communication with the children (stopping bringing up needs and feelings)
antecedent: After communicating with children, feels worse and worries about being seen as complaining
Fearing being judged as overly sensitive
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being rejected and judged, turning outward anger/loss against the self
target_behavior.function: Avoids conflict and negative evaluation to maintain surface harmony
target_behavior.consequence: Parent-child relationship further alienated, subjective sense of exclusion worsens
